fields.Participants: Risk Mgr, Treasury, LP, Insurance Broker, CIT Vendor

workflows.name: CIT Insurance Program, Coverage Limits & Claims Management

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinates with CIT vendor's own coverage to avoid gaps/overlap" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates store vault holding limits align with insurance sub-limits" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files claim with evidence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
- operational: annual coverage review and sub-limit alignment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Coverage risk**: Under-insured vault or uninsured transit gap; mitigated by annual coverage review and sub-limit alignment
System Touchpoints: - Insurance policy repository; holding-limit master; claims tracker
Time Estimate: - 2–3 weeks per annual renewal; per-event variable

steps.activity: Risk Manager structures CIT and cash-on-premises insurance: per-occurrence limits, aggregate, deductible; coordinates with CIT vendor's own coverage to avoid gaps/overlap
Treasury/Risk validates store vault holding limits align with insurance sub-limits; flags over-limit stores for pickup frequency adjustment
On loss event, LP/Risk files claim with evidence; pursues CIT vendor recovery where liable; tracks claim outcome and recovered amount

fields.Participants: LP, Store Manager, Risk, CIT Operations

workflows.name: Cash Holding Limit Compliance & Store Vault Capacity Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-alert of "alert thresholds in ERP" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews holding-limit breaches monthly" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
- operational: automated alerts and pickup triggers
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Over-limit cash raises robbery/insurance risk; mitigated by automated alerts and pickup triggers
System Touchpoints: - Holding-limit master; threshold alert engine; pickup auto-trigger

steps.activity: LP sets per-store cash holding limit based on sales velocity, insurance sub-limit, and vault capacity; configures alert thresholds in ERP
ERP alerts Store Manager and CIT Operations when cash exceeds 80% of holding limit; auto-triggers ad-hoc pickup
LP reviews holding-limit breaches monthly; investigates chronic over-limit stores; adjusts pickup frequency or vault capacity

fields.Participants: LP Investigator, Store Manager, HR, Internal Audit
fields.Trigger: Cash variance beyond tolerance or suspected theft

workflows.name: Cash Loss Event Investigation, LP Correlation & Write-Off

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs, and employee pattern" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "LP Investigator conducts interview with involved staff" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates LP trend dashboard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
- operational: SLA-bounded investigation and trend analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: Unresolved variances accumulate; mitigated by SLA-bounded investigation and trend analysis
System Touchpoints: - LP case management; CCTV-POS correlation; write-off GL

steps.activity: LP Investigator opens case for cash variance > threshold; reviews CCTV, POS exception, smart-safe logs, and employee pattern
LP Investigator conducts interview with involved staff (HR present); documents findings; determines root cause (error vs. theft)
Internal Audit/LP recommends write-off, restitution, or disciplinary action; updates LP trend dashboard; closes case with control remediation

workflows.name: Cash Forecasting, Bank Sweep & Liquidity Optimization

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-forecast of "forecasts store cash generation by region/day" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Treasury executes bank sweep to concentration account" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports cash velocity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
- operational: daily sweep and short-term placement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Opportunity cost**: Idle cash forgoes yield; mitigated by daily sweep and short-term placement
System Touchpoints: - Cash forecast model; bank sweep automation; short-term investment ledger

steps.activity: Treasury forecasts store cash generation by region/day; plans CIT pickup and bank deposit timing to minimize idle cash
Treasury executes bank sweep to concentration account; invests surplus in short-term placements; maintains operating minimum
Finance reports cash velocity (days sales in cash), sweep effectiveness, and yield on surplus placement; recommends optimization

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, Marketing, Finance, Store Ops

workflows.name: Tender Mix Shift Strategy & Cash Reduction Program

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "Marketing designs tender-migration incentives" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks cash % reduction" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Persistent cash-heavy mix raises handling cost; mitigated by data-driven migration incentives
System Touchpoints: - Tender-mix dashboard; campaign management; cost-to-serve analytics

steps.activity: Finance quantifies cost-to-serve by tender (cash handling + CIT + LP vs. card/e-wallet MDR); identifies cash-cost reduction opportunity
Marketing designs tender-migration incentives (e-wallet cashback, loyalty bonus for cardless checkout); deploys in high-cash stores
Payment Ops Manager tracks cash % reduction; reports savings vs. cash-handling cost; refines incentive allocation

Compliance tracks BSP cash-handling guidance (counterfeit reporting, mutilated-note policy) and ensures store protocol alignment
Legal reports serious incidents (robbery, large counterfeit) to PNP/BSP per regulation; maintains compliance evidence for audit

CIT Operations/Payment Ops Manager develop per-store action plan; tracks cost-per-cash-transaction trend

fields.Participants: CIT Ops Mgr, IT, Innovation, Finance, LP

workflows.name: Cash Operations Maturity, Automation & Innovation Roadmap

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measures labor/CIT cost reduction" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports maturity milestones to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-474 (ensure controlled execution — CIT Risk, Insurance & Cash Analytics (PA-81.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Innovation risk**: Falling behind on automation keeps cost elevated; mitigated by annual roadmap and pilots
System Touchpoints: - Innovation pipeline; business-case model; roadmap tracker

steps.activity: CIT Operations/Innovation scouts automation: cash-recyclers (dispense+accept), smart-safe-as-bank-deposit (credit-on-drop), autonomous cash handling
Finance builds business case for cash-recycler rollout; pilots in high-cash stores; measures labor/CIT cost reduction
CIT Operations Manager maintains 3-year cash-operations roadmap; reports maturity milestones to Executive Committee
